title: Design System: Essentia AI Medical Scheduling Assistant

display.purpose: Header wordmark only: Cinzel uppercase, tracking 0.2em.

headline.purpose: Empty-state titles above the gold hairline divider.

title.purpose: Panel headers and appointment service names.

body.purpose: Chat markdown, composer text, list content.

label.purpose: Uppercase status chips and micro-labels with wide tracking.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: Chat shell, side panels, typing bubble. Flat system; rare structural lift only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Committed action: send message, send audio. Bronze fill, inverse icon.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary" type="button" aria-label="Enviar mensagem"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m22 2-7 20-4-9-9-4Z"/><path d="M22 2 11 13"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 12px; border: none; border-radius: 2px; background: #8c733d; color: oklch(0.99 0.005 90); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7a6334; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b89b58; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Primary Button Hover
components.description: Hover/active press state; darkens for AA-safe contrast.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-hover { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 2px; background: #7a6334; color: oklch(0.99 0.005 90); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary-hover:hover { background: #8c733d; } .ds-btn-primary-hover:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b89b58; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost/secondary icon control: mic, refresh, discard.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-secondary" type="button" aria-label="Gravar áudio"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 2a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v7a3 3 0 0 0 6 0V5a3 3 0 0 0-3-3Z"/><path d="M19 10v2a7 7 0 0 1-14 0v-2"/><line x1="12" x2="12" y1="19" y2="22"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.87 0.015 90); border-radius: 2px; background: oklch(0.999 0.003 90); color: oklch(0.5 0.015 80); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.972 0.008 90); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b89b58; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Composer textarea and patient select field chrome.
components.css: .ds-input-text { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.87 0.015 90); border-radius: 2px; background: oklch(0.999 0.003 90); color: oklch(0.22 0.02 80); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4; resize: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input-text::placeholder { color: oklch(0.68 0.012 85); } .ds-input-text:focus { outline: none; border-color: #b89b58; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.88 0.05 90 / 0.6); } .ds-input-text:disabled { background: oklch(0.972 0.008 90); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Side panel and chat shell: parchment, hairline, rare shadow-sm.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.012 90); border-radius: 2px; background: oklch(0.999 0.003 90); color: oklch(0.22 0.02 80); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.012 90); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Appointment status pill: soft tint + tracked uppercase text (never color alone).
components.css: .ds-chip-status { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: oklch(0.965 0.03 250); color: oklch(0.5 0.13 250); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Header Tile
components.description: Brand mark square beside Cinzel wordmark.
components.css: .ds-header-tile { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 2px; background: #8c733d; color: oklch(0.99 0.005 90); flex-shrink: 0; }

components.description: Right-aligned user turn: bronze fill, inverse prose.

narrative.overview:
This system treats the interface as a precision instrument machined from aged brass and warm paper: every surface is flat stock, every division is a hairline, and gold appears only where the instrument requires force (primary action, selection, focus). Restrained clinical luxury means sophistication through subtraction. No decoration earns a pixel unless it carries hierarchy or state.

The palette is deliberately quiet so the scheduling task stays loud. Cinzel appears only at brand moments (header wordmark, empty-state titles); Inter owns every label, control, datum, and markdown body. Geometry is identity: rigid corners (rounded-sm, 2px), 1px rules, wide-tracked uppercase labels, and a thin gold divider as the sole ornamental gesture.

It explicitly rejects the anti-references in PRODUCT.md: generic healthcare SaaS (white + teal/mint gradients, rounded-2xl everything, stock photo cards), consumer chat toys (bubbly radii, purple AI gradients, anthropomorphic avatars, bouncing motion), dark "premium" dashboards with neon accents, landing-page patterns inside the app (hero metrics, gradient text, glassmorphism, side-stripe callouts), and over-decorated or invented affordances for standard tasks.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained: aged brass is the single accent, never ambient decoration
Crisp and quiet controls: dry, sober, Linear/Stripe-earned familiarity
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines; elevation only for floating chat chrome
Roman serif (Cinzel) strictly at brand moments; Inter everywhere else
Rigid 90° geometry, wide-tracked labels, thin horizontal rules
Deterministic honesty: status is text + color, never color alone

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold/bronze is the single accent for primary actions, selection, and focus, never decoration for its own sake. Aged Brass does not fill large surfaces.

rules.name: The No-Warning-Gold Rule
rules.body: Amber warnings must not borrow brand gold. Warnings use the warning tokens and always ship an icon; status is never color alone.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Neutrals Rule
rules.body: Never #000 or #fff. Every neutral carries the brand's warm hue (chroma ~0.005–0.02).

rules.name: The Seal Rule
rules.body: Cinzel only at brand moments: header wordmark and empty-state headings. Inter for every label, control, datum, and markdown body. Type serves hierarchy, not costume.

rules.name: The Tracking Rule
rules.body: Uppercase labels carry 0.12em+ letter-spacing; display wordmark carries 0.2em. Never set uppercase Inter or Cinzel tight.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. shadow-sm only on floating panels; never on rows, chips, or nested children. If a shadow reads as a drop-shadow poster, the blur is wrong for this system.

dos: Do use Burnished Bronze (#8c733d) + Inverse Parchment for every primary action and the user bubble; verify AA for text on bronze.
Do keep corners rigid (rounded-sm, 2px); full radius only on avatars and the recording pulse dot.
Do separate layers with 1px Hairline Sand or border-brand/40 hairlines; wide-track uppercase labels (0.12em+).
Do reserve Cinzel for header wordmark and empty-state titles; Inter for all controls, data, and markdown.
Do pair every status color with text (and icon where the state is failure/warning); use role="alert" for failures.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion; keep motion state-only (spinner, typing dots, recording pulse).
Do show explicit async states (Processando, loading rows, disabled composer) without implying a mutation succeeded until FastAPI history confirms it.
donts: Don't use generic healthcare SaaS: white + teal/mint gradients, rounded-2xl everything, stock photo cards.
Don't use consumer chat toys: bubbly radii, purple AI gradients, anthropomorphic avatars, bouncing decorative motion.
Don't build dark "premium" dashboards with neon accents (wrong ambient light and wrong brand).
Don't use landing-page patterns inside the app: hero metrics, gradient text (background-clip: text), glassmorphism, side-stripe callouts (border-left > 1px as accent).
Don't over-decorate controls or invent affordances; the category/status bar stays Linear/Stripe-style earned familiarity.
Don't put white or small light text on Aged Brass (#b89b58); primary fills stay on Burnished Bronze.
Don't use em dashes (or --) in UI copy; use commas, colons, parentheses, or periods.
Don't animate CSS layout properties; no bounce/elastic easing on controls.
